# Lighting

37 tools. Back to the [index](README.md).

## `configure_light_shadows`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Configure shadow settings for a light actor using preset shadow qualities. Enabled/Disabled switch cast shadows; High, Medium and Low also set ShadowBias, ShadowSlopeBias and ShadowSharpen (0.1/0.1/1.0, 0.2/0.2/0.5, 0.5/0.5/0.0). Everything is read back from the light; it does not touch whether the light affects the world. The change is one undo step that marks the level dirty, and nothing is saved; a light that already has the preset changes nothing and answers shadows_changed false. Changing cast shadows or the bias of a Static-mobility light, which the engine's setters ignore, is an error and nothing is written. Single fields: set_light_properties; cascades: set_directional_light_cascade_settings.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `light_name` | string | yes | Name of the light actor to configure |
| `shadow_settings` | string | yes | Shadow configuration: 'Enabled', 'Disabled', 'High', 'Medium', or 'Low' (case-insensitive); any other name is an error |

**Returns:** `{ light_name, shadow_settings, shadows_configured, shadows_changed, shadow_message, old_cast_shadows, new_cast_shadows, old_affect_world, new_affect_world, shadows_enabled, affect_world, bias_applied, shadow_bias, shadow_slope_bias, shadow_filter_sharpen, light_enabled, light_intensity, light_mobility, light_type, light_atmosphere_sun_light, light_cascade_distribution_exponent, light_cascade_transition_fraction, light_attenuation_radius, light_source_radius, light_source_length, light_inner_cone_angle, light_outer_cone_angle, x, y, z, r, g, b, a }`

## `configure_post_processing`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Apply a post-processing quality preset by setting six renderer console variables with console priority (r.BloomQuality, r.MotionBlurQuality, r.DepthOfFieldQuality, r.AmbientOcclusionLevels, r.LensFlareQuality, r.SSR.Quality); anti-aliasing, global illumination and color grading have none in UE 5.8 and are left alone. Enabled and High set all to 2; Medium sets bloom, depth of field and ambient occlusion to 1, their lowest level above off, and the rest to 0; Disabled and Low set all to 0, so Low equals Disabled. Each variable is read back into post_processing_variables, the *_enabled flags say whether it reads above 0, and one that did not take its level makes success false. The change is engine-wide for this session: no volume is edited, nothing saved or undoable. An unknown preset, or a variable this engine lacks, is an error and nothing changes. Per-volume settings: set_post_process_setting, set_post_process_volume_settings; one variable: set_cvar, get_cvar.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `post_process_settings` | string | yes | Post-processing setting: 'Enabled', 'Disabled', 'High', 'Medium', or 'Low'; case is ignored |

**Returns:** `{ post_process_settings, post_processing_configured, post_processing_message, post_processing_enabled, bloom_enabled, motion_blur_enabled, depth_of_field_enabled, ambient_occlusion_enabled, lens_flare_enabled, screen_space_reflections_enabled, post_processing_variables: [{ variable, previous, requested, value, applied }], world_name, post_process_volume_count, post_process_volume_details: [{ volume_name, volume_class, volume_enabled, volume_unbound, volume_priority, volume_blend_weight, volume_blend_radius, volume_position: { x, y, z } }], post_processing_recommendations, performance_impact, performance_rating }`

## `get_directional_light_cascade_settings`

*Read-only.*

Read the seven Cascaded Shadow Map (CSM) settings of a directional light: dynamic shadow distance (movable/stationary), cascade count, distribution exponent, transition fraction, distance-fadeout fraction, and per-object inset shadows for movable objects. Round-trips set_directional_light_cascade_settings. Errors honestly if the actor is not a directional light.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `light_name` | string | yes | Name of the directional light actor to query |

**Returns:** `{ light_name, light_subtype, dynamic_shadow_distance_movable, dynamic_shadow_distance_stationary, num_dynamic_shadow_cascades, cascade_distribution_exponent, cascade_transition_fraction, shadow_distance_fadeout_fraction, use_inset_shadows_for_movable_objects }`

## `get_lighting_quality`

*Read-only.*

Read-only census of every light component in the editor world (the editor level, even while Play-in-Editor runs), sky lights included, an actor with several counting each: counts by type (sky_light_count among them) and mobility, shadow-casting and world-affecting counts, intensity total/average/min/max over all of them (a sky light's intensity is its scale), one light_details entry per component, plus r.LightingQuality and r.DynamicLighting. lighting_quality_score (0 to 1) and its rating are a heuristic of light count, shadow casters and type variety, not a measure of built lighting; nothing is built. For one light use get_light_properties, for lights near a point get_lighting_in_area.

## `get_shader_info`

*Read-only.*

Read the shading setup the editor runs with, from console variables and the RHI, plus a census of the engine's first world context (normally the editor level); nothing is changed or compiled. shader_type is forward or deferred (r.ForwardShading), shader_api the RHI in use, shader_quality the r.MaterialQualityLevel level; each shader_*_enabled switch, vsync, frame-rate limit and screen percentage comes from its console variable and is omitted when the build lacks it, while shaders_enabled, shader_quality_auto and the platform architecture and OS are fixed. World counts are of actors owning a static mesh, skeletal mesh, light or FX component, plus post-process volumes; material_details lists each distinct material on their first mesh components. The complexity score, rating and recommendations are a heuristic of those counts, not a shader measurement. Renderer summary: get_rendering_settings; lights: get_lighting_quality; one variable: get_cvar.

No parameters.

**Returns:** `{ shader_info_found, shader_info_message, shader_type, shader_quality, shaders_enabled, shader_api, world_name, world_material_count, world_static_mesh_count, world_skeletal_mesh_count, world_light_count, world_post_process_count, world_particle_system_count, material_details: [{ material_name, material_class, material_path, material_is_material, material_is_material_instance, material_is_dynamic_material_instance, material_scalar_parameter_count, material_vector_parameter_count, material_texture_parameter_count, material_total_parameter_count }], engine_version, platform_name, platform_architecture, platform_os, shader_quality_level, shader_quality_preset, shader_quality_auto, shader_quality_score, shader_forward_shading_enabled, shader_deferred_shading_enabled, shader_shadows_enabled, shader_fog_enabled, shader_atmosphere_enabled, shader_anti_aliasing_enabled, shader_motion_blur_enabled, shader_depth_of_field_enabled, shader_ambient_occlusion_enabled, shader_global_illumination_enabled, shader_vsync_enabled, shader_frame_rate_limit, shader_screen_percentage, shader_resolution_scale (each read from its console variable; left out when the build lacks it), shader_recommendations, shader_complexity_score, shader_complexity_rating }`

## `set_directional_light_cascade_settings`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Configure Cascaded Shadow Map (CSM) settings on a directional light: dynamic shadow distance (movable/stationary), cascade count, distribution exponent, transition fraction, distance-fadeout fraction, and per-object inset shadows for movable objects. Partial update (idempotent): only fields present are written; the engine setters auto-dedup, and the inset-shadows bit (no setter) is guarded by hand. The edit is one undo step that marks the level dirty, nothing is saved, and a call that changes nothing leaves neither and says changed false. Errors honestly if the actor is not a directional light. Verify by read-back (every field is echoed) or via get_directional_light_cascade_settings.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `light_name` | string | yes | Name of the directional light actor to modify |
| `dynamic_shadow_distance_movable` | number | no | How far CSM dynamic shadows cover for a movable light, measured from the camera (0 disables) |
| `dynamic_shadow_distance_stationary` | number | no | How far CSM dynamic shadows cover for a stationary light, measured from the camera (0 disables) |
| `num_dynamic_shadow_cascades` | number | no | Number of cascades the view frustum is split into for the whole-scene dynamic shadow |
| `cascade_distribution_exponent` | number | no | Distributes cascades closer (larger) or farther (smaller) from the camera |
| `cascade_transition_fraction` | number | no | Proportion of the blended fade region between cascades (0 = hard transitions) |
| `shadow_distance_fadeout_fraction` | number | no | Size of the fade-out region at the far extent of the dynamic shadow, as a fraction of the shadow distance |
| `use_inset_shadows_for_movable_objects` | boolean | no | Stationary lights: use per-object inset shadows for movable components even though CSM is enabled |

**Returns:** `{ light_name, light_subtype, settings_applied: {...}, applied_count, changed, dynamic_shadow_distance_movable, dynamic_shadow_distance_stationary, num_dynamic_shadow_cascades, cascade_distribution_exponent, cascade_transition_fraction, shadow_distance_fadeout_fraction, use_inset_shadows_for_movable_objects }`

## `set_exponential_height_fog_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set an ExponentialHeightFog actor's fog component, actor found by label or name in the editor world: density, falloff, inscattering, distances, max opacity, volumetric fog, second fog layer, directional inscattering. Over set_properties it needs no component path and goes through the component's own setters; other fog properties: set_properties. Supplied fields only, one undo step, not saved (save_level); applied_count counts them and every property is read back. Colors are [R,G,B(,A)] floats, volumetric_fog_albedo [R,G,B(,A)] whole 0-255 bytes. Every field is checked before any write: a color that is not 3 or 4 numbers, a byte color with a fraction or a value past 255, a number given as a string or a non-boolean volumetric_fog is an error and nothing changes.

## `set_light_color`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the LightColor of one light actor with ULightComponent::SetLightColor: the actor is the first one in the engine's first world context (normally the editor level) whose object name matches light_name and that owns a ULightComponent (a sky light does not). The light stores an 8-bit sRGB color, so each channel is clamped to 0-1 and quantized, and color_set compares the stored color with the quantized request; old_color and new_color are the linear readings before and after. The change is one undo step that marks the level dirty, and nothing is saved; a request that quantizes to the stored color changes nothing (color_changed false). The engine's setter ignores a Static-mobility light, so changing one is an error and nothing is written; an unknown light or unparsable color is an error too. Brightness: set_light_intensity; color temperature: set_light_properties; read back: get_light_properties.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `light_name` | string | yes | Object name of the light actor (e.g. "PointLight_2"), compared case-insensitively; the Outliner label is not matched |
| `color` | string | yes | Color in 'R,G,B,A' or 'R,G,B' format (values 0-1) or hex '#RRGGBB' format; alpha defaults to 1, and in the comma form a part that is not a number reads as 0 |

**Returns:** `{ light_name, requested_color, color_set, color_changed, color_message, old_color: { r, g, b, a }, new_color: { r, g, b, a }, light_enabled, light_cast_shadows, light_affect_world, light_intensity, light_mobility, light_type, light_atmosphere_sun_light?, light_attenuation_radius?, light_inner_cone_angle?, light_outer_cone_angle?, light_position: { x, y, z } }`

## `set_light_intensity`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the Intensity of one light actor with ULightComponent::SetIntensity and read it back: the actor is the first one in the engine's first world context (normally the editor level) whose object name matches light_name and that owns a ULightComponent (a sky light does not). The change is one undo step that marks the level dirty; nothing is saved. A request equal to the current intensity changes nothing, records no undo step and answers intensity_changed false. The engine's setter ignores a Static-mobility light, so changing one is an error and nothing is written; an unknown light or a missing intensity is an error too. Color: set_light_color; temperature, radius and the other fields: set_light_properties; shadows: configure_light_shadows; full read-back: get_light_properties.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `light_name` | string | yes | Object name of the light actor (e.g. "PointLight_2"), compared case-insensitively; the Outliner label is not matched |
| `intensity` | number | yes | New intensity as a float in the light's own units (lux for a directional light, its intensity units for a local light); not clamped |

**Returns:** `{ light_name, old_intensity, new_intensity, requested_intensity, intensity_set, intensity_changed, intensity_message, light_enabled, light_cast_shadows, light_affect_world, light_mobility, light_type, light_atmosphere_sun_light?, light_attenuation_radius?, light_inner_cone_angle?, light_outer_cone_angle?, light_position: { x, y, z }, light_color: { r, g, b, a } }`

## `set_light_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set component-level properties of one light actor, found by object name (not Outliner label) in the first world context: attenuation and source radius/length, cone angles, temperature, indirect/volumetric intensity, translucency, RectLight source size, barn doors and texture, IES profile, light function, shadow bias, cast/volumetric shadows, contact shadows and inverse-squared falloff. Over set_properties it needs no component path, returns a note for a field that does not apply to the light's type, and on a Static-mobility light refuses, writing nothing, any field whose engine setter skips static lights (IES, light function, shadow bias, cast flags, falloff, RectLight source and barn doors). Only fields present change, as one undo step that dirties the level; nothing is saved; a no-op says changed false. Intensity: set_light_intensity; color: set_light_color. Read back with get_light_properties.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `light_name` | string | yes | Name of the light actor to modify. |
| `attenuation_radius` | number | no | float, light reach — local lights only (Point/Spot/Rect). |
| `source_radius` | number | no | float, soft source radius (Point/Spot). |
| `soft_source_radius` | number | no | float (Point/Spot). |
| `source_length` | number | no | float, line-source length (Point/Spot). |
| `inner_cone_angle` | number | no | float degrees (Spot only). |
| `outer_cone_angle` | number | no | float degrees (Spot only). |
| `temperature` | number | no | float Kelvin color temperature (all lights; pair with use_temperature). |
| `use_temperature` | boolean | no | bool, enable color temperature (all lights). |
| `indirect_lighting_intensity` | number | no | float (all lights). |
| `volumetric_scattering_intensity` | number | no | float (all lights). |
| `affect_translucent_lighting` | boolean | no | bool (all lights). |
| `ies_texture` | string | no | asset path to a UTextureLightProfile (IES profile); omit/empty leaves it unchanged (all lights). |
| `use_ies_brightness` | boolean | no | bool, use the IES profile's brightness (all lights). |
| `ies_brightness_scale` | number | no | float, IES brightness multiplier (all lights). |
| `light_function_material` | string | no | asset path to a UMaterialInterface light-function material; omit/empty leaves it unchanged (all lights). |
| `light_function_scale` | array | no | [x,y,z] float array, light-function projection scale (all lights). |
| `light_function_fade_distance` | number | no | float, distance at which the light function fades out (all lights). |
| `light_function_disabled_brightness` | number | no | float, brightness where the light function is faded out (all lights). |
| `shadow_bias` | number | no | float, dynamic-shadow depth bias (all lights). |
| `cast_shadows` | boolean | no | bool, whether the light casts shadows (all lights). |
| `cast_volumetric_shadow` | boolean | no | bool, whether the light casts volumetric (beam) shadows (all lights). |
| `contact_shadow_length` | number | no | float, screen-space contact-shadow ray length (all lights). |
| `contact_shadow_length_in_ws` | boolean | no | bool, interpret contact_shadow_length in world space instead of screen space (all lights). |
| `use_inverse_squared_falloff` | boolean | no | bool, physically-based inverse-square falloff (Point/Spot). |
| `falloff_exponent` | number | no | float, manual falloff exponent when inverse-squared is off (Point/Spot). |
| `source_width` | number | no | float, RectLight emissive width (Rect only). |
| `source_height` | number | no | float, RectLight emissive height (Rect only). |
| `barn_door_angle` | number | no | float degrees, RectLight barn-door opening angle (Rect only). |
| `barn_door_length` | number | no | float, RectLight barn-door length (Rect only). |
| `source_texture` | string | no | asset path to a UTexture for the RectLight surface; omit/empty leaves it unchanged (Rect only). |

**Returns:** `{ light_name, light_subtype, settings_applied: {...}, notes: [string], applied_count, changed }`

## `set_lumen_gi_quality`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Applies Lumen / global-illumination scene tuning via console variables.  Provide exactly one of:     quality: "Low" | "Medium" | "High" | "Epic" | "Cinematic"         -> sg.GlobalIlluminationQuality (scalability group 0..4), read back.     method:  "Lumen" | "ScreenSpace" | "None"         -> r.DynamicGlobalIlluminationMethod (0=None,1=Lumen,2=ScreenSpace), read back.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quality` | string | no | One of "Low" \| "Medium" \| "High" \| "Epic" \| "Cinematic" (mutually exclusive with method) |
| `method` | string | no | One of "Lumen" \| "ScreenSpace" \| "None" (mutually exclusive with quality) |

**Returns:** `{ mode: string, cvar: string, requested_method: string?, requested_quality: string?, requested_value: number, value: number, applied: bool }`

## `set_post_process_color_grading`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the global AND per-range (shadows/midtones/highlights) color-grading wheels plus white balance and the range pivots on a PostProcessVolume.  Each wheel is an FVector4 [R, G, B, master]; white balance and pivots are scalars — set_post_process_setting never covered these. Setting a field also turns on its bOverride flag (so it takes effect) and reads the value back. Only the supplied fields change.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label/name of the target PostProcessVolume actor. |
| `saturation` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] saturation (default master 1.0; neutral is [1,1,1,1]). |
| `contrast` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] contrast (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `gamma` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] gamma (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `gain` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] gain (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `offset` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] offset (default master 0.0; neutral is [0,0,0,0]). |
| `saturation_shadows` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] saturation for the shadows range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `saturation_midtones` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] saturation for the midtones range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `saturation_highlights` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] saturation for the highlights range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `contrast_shadows` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] contrast for the shadows range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `contrast_midtones` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] contrast for the midtones range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `contrast_highlights` | array | no | Optional [R, G, B, master] contrast for the highlights range (neutral [1,1,1,1]). |
| `white_temp` | number | no | Optional white balance temperature (Kelvin, e.g. 6500 neutral). |
| `white_tint` | number | no | Optional white balance tint. |
| `shadows_max` | number | no | Optional pivot: upper bound of the shadows range. |
| `highlights_min` | number | no | Optional pivot: lower bound of the highlights range. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, settings_applied: object (wheels as arrays, white_temp/white_tint/shadows_max/highlights_min as numbers), applied_count: int, applied: bool }`

## `set_post_process_setting`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Sets a post-process setting on a PostProcessVolume (sets bOverride flag + field, reads back).          exposure (auto_exposure_bias), exposure_min, exposure_max, exposure_method         (0=Histogram,1=Basic,2=Manual), lumen_gi / dynamic_global_illumination_method         (0=None,1=Lumen,2=ScreenSpace,3=Plugin)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label/name of the target PostProcessVolume actor |
| `setting` | string | yes | One of: bloom_intensity, vignette_intensity, ambient_occlusion_intensity, |
| `value` | number | yes | Numeric value to apply (enum index for method/gi settings) |

## `set_post_process_volume_settings`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set enabled, priority, film_grain_intensity and motion_blur_amount of a PostProcessVolume in the editor world as one undo step; only the fields you pass change, and film grain and motion blur also get their bOverride flag so they take effect. The level is not saved. Returns applied_count and applied_fields; other settings use set_post_process_setting.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `volume_name` | string | yes | Editor label of the PostProcessVolume in the editor world; object names are not matched. |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | Whether the volume is enabled (APostProcessVolume bEnabled). |
| `priority` | number | no | Blend priority among overlapping volumes, a number such as 1; a numeric string is also accepted. |
| `film_grain_intensity` | number | no | Film grain intensity from 0 to 1, a number; a numeric string is also accepted. |
| `motion_blur_amount` | number | no | Motion blur strength from 0 to 1 (0 is off), a number; a numeric string is also accepted. |

**Returns:** `{ volume_name, applied_count, applied_fields: [string] }`

## `set_reflection_capture_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set influence radius (Sphere), transition distance and extent (Box), brightness or cubemap of a Sphere or Box reflection-capture actor found by label or name in the editor world, then mark it dirty for recapture and read each field back. Over set_properties: box_extent maps to the actor scale (the box capture has no extent property), brightness is clamped to [0.5, 4] and a cubemap also switches ReflectionSourceType to SpecifiedCubemap. A param for the other capture shape is a no-op reported as &lt;prop>_set=false. A box_extent that is not exactly 3 numbers, or a cubemap path that does not load as a TextureCube, fails the call before anything is written. Nothing is saved (save_level).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or internal name of the reflection-capture actor |
| `influence_radius` | number | no | Sphere capture InfluenceRadius in cm (Sphere only) |
| `box_transition_distance` | number | no | Box capture BoxTransitionDistance (Box only) |
| `brightness` | number | no | Capture Brightness multiplier (clamped to [0.5, 4]) |
| `box_extent` | array | no | Box capture extent as actor scale [X, Y, Z] (Box only; SetActorScale3D). Anything but an array of exactly 3 numbers fails the call and nothing is changed, on a Sphere capture too. |
| `cubemap` | string | no | Path to a UTextureCube; assigning it sets ReflectionSourceType=SpecifiedCubemap. A path that does not load as a TextureCube fails the call and nothing is changed. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, actor_internal_name: string, capture_type: string, influence_radius_set: bool, influence_radius: number, box_transition_distance_set: bool, box_transition_distance: number, brightness_set: bool, brightness: number, box_extent_set: bool, box_extent: [number], cubemap_set: bool, cubemap: string, reflection_source_type: string, marked_dirty: bool }`

## `set_scene_capture_2d_properties`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set CaptureSource, ProjectionType, FOVAngle, TextureTarget and bCaptureEveryFrame of a SceneCapture2D actor's capture component, found by label or name in the editor world, without capturing or saving. Beyond set_properties it adds only the label lookup and lenient enum names (SCS_ prefix optional, case-insensitive); write any other field with set_properties. An unknown capture_source or projection_type, or a texture_target that does not load as a TextureRenderTarget2D, fails the call before anything is written. Returns each field read back with a *_set flag; get_scene_capture_2d_properties reads them.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_name` | string | yes | Label or internal name of the SceneCapture2D actor |
| `capture_source` | string | no | ESceneCaptureSource (e.g. SceneColorHDR \| FinalColorLDR \| FinalColorHDR \| SceneDepth); the SCS_ prefix is optional; any other value fails the call and nothing is changed |
| `projection_type` | string | no | Projection mode, "Perspective" or "Orthographic" (case-insensitive); any other value fails the call and nothing is changed; omit to keep the current one |
| `fov_angle` | number | no | Field-of-view angle in degrees (FOVAngle field) |
| `texture_target` | string | no | Path to a UTextureRenderTarget2D to assign; a path that does not load as one fails the call and nothing is changed |
| `capture_every_frame` | boolean | no | Whether the component captures every frame (bCaptureEveryFrame) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, actor_internal_name: string, capture_source_set: bool, capture_source: string, projection_type_set: bool, projection_type: string, fov_angle_set: bool, fov_angle: number, texture_target_set: bool, texture_target: string, has_render_target: bool, capture_every_frame_set: bool, capture_every_frame: bool }`

## `set_sky_atmosphere_properties`

Set atmosphere fields (Rayleigh/Mie scattering, anisotropy, ground albedo, radius, height, multi-scattering, aerial perspective, height fog) of a SkyAtmosphere actor found by label or name, through the component's setters, which refresh its render state; set_properties writes any other field. Only supplied fields change, in one undo step; all are read back. Colors are linear [R,G,B(,A)], ground_albedo [R,G,B(,A)] whole 0-255 bytes. A malformed field, or a component of Static mobility (its setters change nothing; make it Movable first), is an error and nothing changes. Not saved.

| `rayleigh_scattering` | array | no | Optional [R,G,B(,A)] Rayleigh scattering color. |
| `rayleigh_scattering_scale` | number | no | Optional Rayleigh scattering scale. |
| `mie_scattering` | array | no | Optional [R,G,B(,A)] Mie scattering color. |
| `mie_scattering_scale` | number | no | Optional Mie scattering scale. |
| `mie_anisotropy` | number | no | Optional Mie anisotropy (0..1). |
| `ground_albedo` | array | no | Optional [R,G,B] or [R,G,B,A] ground albedo, each a whole number from 0 to 255 (FColor; A defaults to 255). |
| `bottom_radius` | number | no | Optional planet bottom radius (km). |
| `atmosphere_height` | number | no | Optional atmosphere height (km). |
| `multi_scattering_factor` | number | no | Optional multi-scattering factor (0..2). |
| `aerial_perspective_view_distance_scale` | number | no | Optional aerial perspective view distance scale. |
| `height_fog_contribution` | number | no | Optional height fog contribution (0..1). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, properties: object, applied_count: int, applied: bool }`

## `spawn_box_reflection_capture`

*Additive.*

Spawn a BoxReflectionCapture actor into the editor world at location in one undo step, optionally set its Brightness (read back), and mark it dirty for recapture. spawn_actor has no reflection-capture type; spawn_sphere_reflection_capture places a sphere probe. Each call adds an actor; not saved (save_level). Tune: set_reflection_capture_properties.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `location` | array | no | Optional [X, Y, Z] world location (defaults to origin) |
| `brightness` | number | no | Optional Brightness multiplier on the capture component |

## `spawn_exponential_height_fog`

*Additive.*

Spawn a new ExponentialHeightFog actor in the editor world at location (no rotation) as one undoable transaction, without checking for an existing one, so each call adds another fog actor (not idempotent); nothing is saved (save_level). spawn_actor has no fog type, and this one also seeds fog_density: when given, it is written to its UExponentialHeightFogComponent with SetFogDensity and density_set turns true; either way the reply reads fog_density back from the component, so without the param it shows the class default. No editor world, or a failed spawn, is an error. actor_name is the label and actor_internal_name the object name. Tune or inspect an existing fog with set_exponential_height_fog_properties and get_exponential_height_fog_properties; other atmosphere actors: spawn_sky_atmosphere, spawn_volumetric_cloud or spawn_sky_light.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `location` | array | no | Optional [X, Y, Z] world location in cm (defaults to origin); any other value is an error and nothing is spawned |
| `fog_density` | number | no | Optional fog density multiplier; if supplied, applied to the component and read back |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, actor_internal_name: string, actor_class: string, density_set: bool, fog_density: number, spawned: bool }`

## `spawn_post_process_volume`

*Additive.*

Spawn a new PostProcessVolume actor in the editor world at location in one undo step, unbound (affecting the whole world) by default; not saved (save_level). It builds NO brush, so unbound=false covers no space: for a bounded volume use spawn_box_volume(volume_class='PostProcessVolume'). spawn_actor has no post-process type. Returns actor_name (the label), actor_internal_name, unbound and enabled. Configure it with set_post_process_setting or set_post_process_color_grading.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `location` | array | no | [X, Y, Z] world location in cm; defaults to the origin. Any other value (an object, another length) is an error and nothing is spawned. |
| `unbound` | boolean | no | true (default) makes the volume affect the whole world; false limits it to its brush, which this spawn leaves without geometry, so it then covers no space. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, actor_internal_name: string, actor_class: string, unbound: bool, enabled: bool, spawned: bool }`

## `spawn_scene_capture_2d`

*Additive.*

Spawn a SceneCapture2D actor in the editor world (also while PIE runs, never into PIE) at location and rotation, in one undo step; the level is marked dirty but not saved. spawn_actor has no scene-capture type. Each call spawns another actor (not idempotent) under the engine default label: actor_name is that label, actor_internal_name the object name to address it by later. A fresh capture has no render target, so has_render_target is false until one is assigned. Set its TextureTarget, capture source, projection and FOV with set_scene_capture_2d_properties (a target comes from create_render_target_2d), read them back with get_scene_capture_2d_properties. A reflection probe is spawn_sphere_reflection_capture or spawn_box_reflection_capture.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `location` | array | no | Optional [X, Y, Z] world location; missing means the origin, and any other value is an error and nothing is spawned |
| `rotation` | array | no | Optional world rotation in degrees, as [Pitch, Yaw, Roll] or {"pitch", "yaw", "roll"} by name (defaults to zero) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_name: string, actor_internal_name: string, actor_class: string, has_component: bool, has_render_target: bool, spawned: bool }`

## `update_reflection_captures`

*Destructive.*

Rebuilds reflection-capture contents for all captures in the editor world.  Marks every reflection capture dirty and runs the canonical editor rebuild path (UReflectionCaptureComponent::UpdateReflectionCaptureContents).

No parameters.

**Returns:** `{ updated: bool, capture_count: number }`
